'''Shrines''' ---- '''Shrines''' are a special mechanic in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes that appear every 10 waves. It is an optional feature which temporarily makes the match harder in exchange for boosting rewards gotten from a match.
==Mechanics== [[File:HardcoreReworkDI3.png|150px|thumb|The Decay '''Shrine''' statue]] In [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes, starting on Wave 11, a random '''Shrine''' statue will emerge from the ground at a random section of the map every 10 waves with a UI notification and server chat message. Players are able to activate the shrine for {{Money|400}}, which increases by {{Money|200}} every time a new shrine appears. If a '''Shrine''' is not activated, it will disappear after 5 waves until the next shrine appears. If a player activates a shrine, a modifier will be enabled that will negatively affect the gameplay. While a '''Shrine''' is active, a timer will appear above it showing how many waves are left before it deactivates. Upon activation, players will also get an extra gem reward that is only rewarded on triumph. ==Shrines== {{Shrine |name = Beggar |icon = BeggarShrine.png |info = Upgrades cost +20% for 3 waves. |description = All upgrade costs are increased by 20%. Does not affect placement costs. Lasts 3 waves. |reward = {{Gem|50}} }} {{Shrine |name = Champion |icon = ChampionShrine.png |info = Enemies spawn with 40% more health for 3 waves. |description = Boosts enemy health by 40% through [[Bloated]]. Lasts 3 waves. |reward = {{Gem|60}} }} {{Shrine |name = Decay |icon = DecayShrine.png |info = Base loses 5% max HP every 5 seconds for 5 waves. |description = Deals damage equal to 5% of the max base health every 5 seconds, but it cannot kill the players. Lasts 5 waves. |reward = {{Gem|40}} }} {{Shrine |name = Marathon |icon = MarathonShrine.png |info = Enemies gain a 50% speed buff for 4 waves. |description = Enemies gain a 50% speed buff that is different from [[Nimble]]. Lasts 4 waves. |reward = {{Gem|40}} }} {{Shrine |name = Vision |icon = VisionShrine.png |info = Towers have 30% less range for 3 waves. |description = Tower range is reduced by 30%. Lasts 3 waves. |reward = {{Gem|50}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Statues}} BeggarShrineStatue.png|Beggar ChampionShrineStatue.png|Champion DecayShrineStatue.png|Decay MarathonShrineStatue.png|Marathon VisionShrineStatue.png|Vision }} ==Trivia== *The icons for the '''Shrines''' are taken from the [[Hardcore Lobby]], which had five symbols that could be pressed but did nothing. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Shrines''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **All shrines were changed. **'''Beggar''': ***Description changed.
